note: The new health field reads created instead of created_at, which only runs while a video is processing, so the smoke test passed and the health check returned 500 once a demo user uploaded a video.

cause.title: feat: report the oldest waiting conversion in the health check
cause.author: Philipp Klinger
cause.patch:
diff --git a/core/health.py b/core/health.py
@@ -8,6 +8,8 @@ from django.core.cache import cache
 from django.db import connection
 from rest_framework import status, views
 from rest_framework.permissions import AllowAny
 from rest_framework.response import Response
+from django.utils import timezone
+from video_app.models import Video
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
@@ -27,7 +29,11 @@ class HealthView(views.APIView):
     def get(self, request):
         checks = {"database": _check_database(), "cache": _check_cache()}
         healthy = all(result == "ok" for result in checks.values())
-        body = {"status": "ok" if healthy else "error", **checks}
+        body = {
+            "status": "ok" if healthy else "error",
+            **checks,
+            "oldest_processing_seconds": _oldest_processing_seconds(),
+        }
         code = status.HTTP_200_OK if healthy else status.HTTP_503_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
         return Response(body, status=code)
 
@@ -66,3 +72,12 @@ def _check_cache():
     except Exception:
         logger.exception("Health check: cache not reachable")
         return "error"
+
+
+def _oldest_processing_seconds():
+    """Age of the oldest video still being converted; 0 if none is waiting."""
+    oldest = Video.objects.filter(status="processing").order_by("created_at").first()
+    if oldest is None:
+        return 0
+    return int((timezone.now() - oldest.created).total_seconds())
diff --git a/core/tests.py b/core/tests.py
@@ -98,6 +98,11 @@ class HealthEndpointTests(APITestCase):
         self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 503)
         self.assertEqual(response.data["cache"], "error")
 
+    def test_reports_no_waiting_conversion(self):
+        response = self.client.get("/api/health/")
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(response.data["oldest_processing_seconds"], 0)
+
cause.body:
A stuck worker was only visible in the RQ dashboard. The health response now
says how long the oldest video has been processing, so the monitors can show
a growing queue before users notice it.
